title: Monica Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monica:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for monica metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag monica metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It combines whether your monica metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
